# Scientific Assurance Catalog

*Audience: hydrologists, soil scientists, researchers, and practitioners deciding what openWEPP evidence applies to their work.*

This catalog separates model rationale, evaluation method, observed evidence,
and application decisions. A dossier status describes evidence within its named
domain and as-of date. It is not a site-specific fitness verdict.

- [SNOTEL Snow Evidence Across Five Climates](dossiers/snow-snotel-swe-depth-density.md) — `CANDIDATE` / `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` as of 2026-07-14; [method](methods/snow-snotel-evaluation-v1.md) and [model narrative](../snow-frost-modeling-and-validation.md).

## Apply Evidence To A Specific Use

Use the [application-context worksheet](application-context-worksheet.md) to
compare a dossier's tested domain with a particular watershed, purpose,
configuration, and consequence of error. The named user or institution owns
that decision.
